# GetMyWebsite

> GetMyWebsite is a digital studio in India that builds signature websites, AI automations, agentic AI systems, and AI videos as one connected system.

GetMyWebsite designs, launches, and scales the site, the workflows behind it, and the video that explains the offer. Work is scoped per project. Rankings, traffic, and results are not guaranteed.

## Services

- [Signature Website](https://getmywebsite.co.in/signature-website/): Custom website design and development for businesses in India. Starts at INR 9,999. Final price depends on design, features, integrations, and scope.
- [AI Automations](https://getmywebsite.co.in/ai-automations/): WhatsApp workflows, AI chatbots, voice assistants, CRM updates, appointment flows, and other repetitive-task automation. Quoted per workflow.
- [Agentic AI](https://getmywebsite.co.in/agentic-ai/): Goal-driven AI agents that plan steps and act across approved tools, apps, APIs, and data. Guardrails and human handoff are part of the build.
- [AI Videos](https://getmywebsite.co.in/ai-videos/): Prompt-to-video production with characters, voiceovers, and brand styles for ads, product films, and social clips.

## Who it is for

Businesses, founders, clinics, restaurants, real estate teams, salons, gyms, and professional firms in India that need a website, automation, an AI agent, or AI video without stitching together multiple vendors.

## How to start

Share the service needed, the pages or workflows involved, and any tools that must connect. GetMyWebsite replies with a scoped quote and an estimated timeline.

Contact: https://getmywebsite.co.in/#contact
